subject.title: fix(sessions): prune stale entries independently of maxEntries gate

question: Should `pruneAfter` remain pressure-gated in automatic maintenance, or become an unconditional wall-clock deletion deadline across every maintenance path?
rationale: The PR changes persisted-session retention semantics, while current production code and the linked issue analysis support pressure-gated, artifact-aware maintenance; repository evidence cannot establish a new deletion policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve pressure-gated retention
options.body: Restore the load gate and re-scope the work to canonical config diagnostics and precise retention documentation.

options.title: Adopt unconditional age deletion
options.body: Define and implement the new policy consistently in the artifact-aware production owner with fresh-install and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve pressure-gated retention
recommendation.body: Restore the load gate and re-scope the work to canonical config diagnostics and precise retention documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns preservation invariants across the affected session-maintenance paths.
